prd.title: Oracle Loop Improvement: Fix Spinning and Root Cause Analysis
prd.target: Fix infrastructure bugs causing infinite spinning and analysis bugs causing wrong fixes

executive_summary: The oracle loop is failing for two reasons: (1) infrastructure bugs cause infinite spinning (baseline parsing broken, no progress guardrail), and (2) analysis quality bugs cause it to fix the wrong problems (narrator detection uses flawed pronoun density algorithm). This PRD addresses both categories simultaneously to restore meaningful autonomous improvement.

whats_improved: Oracle loop shell script exists and runs
State tracking via EVALUATION_STATE.md works conceptually
Regression gate concept exists in oracle-loop.sh
problem_statement.core_problem: Infrastructure Bugs + Wrong Root Cause Analysis

current_failures.root_cause: Regex assumes plain text but state file uses markdown bold formatting
current_failures.impact: Regression auto-revert never triggers, loop iterates on degraded baseline

current_failures.example: Claude exits without making changes, loop immediately restarts same phase
current_failures.root_cause: No check that state files changed between iterations
current_failures.impact: Burns tokens/time on iterations that accomplish nothing

current_failures.example: Amontillado (wine) identified as narrator because contexts around it have high 'I' density
current_failures.root_cause: Algorithm measures pronouns AROUND mentions, not who pronouns REFER TO
current_failures.impact: Wrong narrator cascades to wrong plot summary and profiles

current_failures.issue: Plot summary uses wrong character signal
current_failures.example: Highest mention count = main character, so wine (16 mentions) outranks narrator (1 mention)
current_failures.root_cause: Character selection only considers mention count, not role or type
current_failures.impact: LLM writes 'Amontillado recounts...' based on mention count

features.name: Fix Baseline Parsing
features.rationale: Regression gate cannot fire if baseline is always parsed as 0
features.current_behavior: grep -oP '(?<=baseline_score: )' returns empty because format is '**baseline_score:**'
features.proposed_behavior: Parse baseline from manifest.json using jq, or fix sed pattern to match markdown format

user_stories.description: Baseline parsing extracts correct value from EVALUATION_STATE.md
steps: Verify returned value is 6.45 (not 0 or empty)

user_stories.description: Regression gate triggers on score drop
steps: Verify regression gate detects 0.50 drop > 0.3 threshold

changes.description: Replace grep -oP with jq reading from manifest.json or sed matching markdown format

features.name: Add No-Progress Guardrail
features.rationale: Loop can spin forever if Claude makes no state changes
features.current_behavior: Loop restarts immediately after Claude exits, even if nothing changed
features.proposed_behavior: Hash state files before/after each iteration, exit after 3 consecutive no-progress iterations

steps: Run loop with prompt that makes no state changes
Verify warning logged: 'No state change detected'
Verify counter increments each no-progress iteration
Run loop with prompt that never changes state
Verify error message: '3 consecutive no-progress iterations'

files.description: Add state hashing and progress detection

changes.description: Hash EVALUATION_STATE.md + manifest.json before/after Claude run, track consecutive no-change count

features.name: Make Parsing Portable
features.rationale: grep -P (Perl regex) not available on all systems
features.current_behavior: Phase and name extraction use grep -oP which fails silently on some systems
features.proposed_behavior: Use portable sed/awk for all state file parsing

user_stories.description: Phase detection works without Perl regex
steps: Run phase extraction with sed (not grep -P)

user_stories.description: Name extraction works without Perl regex
steps: Run name extraction with sed (not grep -P)

features.name: Fix Spec Drift
features.rationale: Evaluate prompt references wrong file path, causing silent failures

user_stories.description: Evaluate prompt uses correct file path
steps: Run evaluation, verify no file-not-found errors

features.name: Fix Narrator Detection Algorithm
features.rationale: Current algorithm misidentifies narrator, causing cascade of downstream errors
features.current_behavior: Counts first-person pronouns in context window around character mentions; highest density wins. Fails because narrator says 'I' while discussing objects.
features.proposed_behavior: Hybrid approach: (1) Direct address detection - find patterns like 'Name!' in dialogue where narrator is being addressed, (2) LLM fallback - ask 'who is the I?' if no direct address found

steps: Analyze 'The Cask of Amontillado' (contains 'For the love of God, Montresor!')

user_stories.description: LLM fallback works when no direct address
steps: Analyze text with first-person narrator but no direct address
Verify LLM is asked 'who is the I in this text?'
Check narrator identified from LLM response

user_stories.description: Narrator detection no longer uses pronoun density
steps: Verify 'Amontillado' is NOT identified as narrator
Verify pronoun density around mentions is NOT calculated

user_stories.description: Narrator detection works for The Great Gatsby
steps: Check narrator is marked in character list

changes.description: Replace pronoun density algorithm with: 1) Direct address regex for 'Name!' patterns in dialogue, 2) LLM query 'who is the I?' as fallback

features.name: Fix Plot Summary Character Selection
features.rationale: Using only mention count puts objects above actual protagonists
features.current_behavior: Sorts characters by mention_count, takes top 3 as 'main characters'
features.proposed_behavior: Score characters by: mention count + narrator boost + role weight, filter non-persons first

user_stories.description: Narrator gets boosted in character selection
steps: Verify Montresor (narrator, 1 mention) ranks higher than Amontillado (wine, 16 mentions)
Check plot summary refers to 'Montresor' as narrator
Analyze text with object having high mention count
Verify object is not in 'main characters' list sent to LLM
Analyze text with protagonist, antagonist, and minor characters
Verify protagonist ranks higher than minor character with same mention count
Check role is factored into scoring

changes.description: Add narrator boost (2x), role weight (protagonist 1.5x), filter to persons only before sorting
